Review CapCut?

Reviewers mostly see CapCut as an easy, fast way to make short-form videos, especially for TikTok, Reels, and other social posts. They often praise its intuitive workflow, templates, auto-captions, transitions, effects, and beginner-friendly editing on desktop and mobile. The main complaints are repeated: more features moving behind a Pro paywall, watermarks and trial confusion in the free tier, plus some technical friction like weak browser support, lag, export speed, and rough mobile-desktop syncing. A few users also report serious billing and support problems.
